sources.title: Open Terms Archive - Platform Governance Archive versions
sources.watch_urls_absent_reason: The archive is itself a change feed; watching it is the point, and it has no announcement page of its own.
sources.carries: Evidence that a tracked document changed, and when. Nothing else.
sources.does_not_carry: Anything quotable. Its role is change_signal: it can send a run to an official page, and it can never stand in for one. Coverage also skews to community guidelines, terms and privacy policies rather than the monetization help pages, so a silent archive is not evidence that a monetization rule held still. Measured 2026-09-10 against its own listing: it tracks no Bilibili documents at all, so it is not a change feed for that platform and a quiet archive says nothing about a Bilibili rule holding still. A Bilibili-specific change feed is still a registry gap.
